verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's own pricing docs say it charges the same rates as the underlying provider with no added fees. Its `:cheapest` routing policy ranks providers by price per output token, which implies per-token prices exist and are tracked per provider. However, no evidence shows a public, browsable per-token price list covering every hosted model. missing for 10: a documented public per-model per-token price table, confirmation that it covers every hosted model, and independent corroboration that pricing is self-serve with no sales contact.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales

citations.quote: Hugging Face charges you the same rates as the provider, with no additional fees.
